method.unit: Summed top-level weekly aggregate GeoJSON swarm weights; repeated peers may recur. Not unique people or completed downloads.
method.geography: USA and Asia-28 (including TWN); worldwide denominators retain other and unclassified countries.
method.shares: Each role and field divides by its corresponding worldwide role/field total. Mobile, hosting and VPN rates divide by country/region size.
method.selection: AAPI side: confirmed aapi-led, USA production, >=2 confirmed USA citizens. Global side: confirmed asian-led-global, non-USA production, <=1 confirmed USA citizens. These identity slices overlap.
method.adjustment: Geographic shares and raw weights; no Internet-user multiplier is applied to this paired geography analysis.
